name: @caisson/service-docs
description: AI-native docs corpus + retrieval service (P6, ADR-0096/0009). Builds a chunked, agent-queryable corpus from the repo's authoritative docs, emits a canonical llms.txt, and serves a typed POST /query retrieval contract that the (Python) support-bot and buyer agents consume cross-language. Read-by-agents — distinct from apps/site's read-by-humans Fumadocs site.
